description: Parse an ssh_known_hosts file (or a single `host keytype base64key` line) and compute each entry's SHA256 and MD5 fingerprint the same way `ssh-keygen -lf` does, decoding the key type and, for RSA, the modulus bit length, flagging a weak RSA key (<2048 bits) or a deprecated ssh-dss (DSA) key.

input.description: ssh_known_hosts file contents, or a single entry line

name: check_known_hosts_fingerprints
